scientific_integrity: Finite verification is supplemental to the exact field-count proof and weight-two Frobenius argument. Geometric Picard rank uses the established odd-characteristic K3 Tate theorem; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact zeta calculation is for the displayed prime-field Schur model. No Artin invariant, integral Picard lattice, Kummer model isomorphism, or complete historical priority certification is supplied. Exhaustive point counts cover F5 and F25 only; later counts are mathematical consequences of K3 purity. Full text of arXiv:2607.07898 was not accessible.
title: The exact zeta function of Schur’s quartic in characteristic five
